Commentary.Commentary: We're done with this match. The next set of two warm-up games involving Afghanistan and West Indies, Pakistan and South Africa will begin shortly at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). You can now switch tabs and get all the updates. Cheers!

Apart from a bit of extra work towards the end, England will be satisfied with their bowling show. They were put under pressure initially by Martin Guptill but after that, the English bowlers picked up the intensity in the middle overs. As mentioned earlier, Adil Rashid picked three crucial wickets and was quite handy with his variations. The English batting though still needs to get more effective and sharp. Jos Buttler had a good outing and Sam Billings also showed his skills in the death overs but the form of Jason Roy, Eoin Morgan and Dawid Malan remains a big concern for them.

It was a stiff target for New Zealand but apart from Martin Guptill and his stand with Devon Conway, there wasn't much fight shown. Todd Astle and Ish Sodhi did put up a good resistance but you can't take a lot of confidence from their partnership. All the other Kiwi batters looked in a hurry and England had no qualms in giving them the return ticket. Adil Rashid bounced back well after a disappointing show against India and picked up three wickets. Mark Wood also bowled with a lot of fire and pace and claimed a 4-wicket haul. Not the kind of outing the Blackcaps would have planned for but at least they now know the areas they need to focus on.

Great fight from the final partnership but eventually, England managed to cross the line. From 103/9, the Three Lions let the game drift away a bit and can certainly not afford to do that in the main tournament. To close the game effectively is something England would like to do better in the coming games.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Chris Woakes ends the game well for England. Todd Astle and Ish Sodhi gave them a nervy end but the Brits do well to cross the line here. This is bowled slightly shorter, around off and middle, Todd Astle gets inside the line and looks to work this to the leg side but the ball takes the thigh pad and clips the top of the leg pole. England win by 13 runs!
This is bowled in the blockhole, around off, Ish digs this one towards covers for a single.
15 needed off 6 balls. Can New Zealand pull it off? Chris Woakes to bowl...

SIX! What a great strike! This brings the equation down for the Kiwis as they need 15 more from the last 6 balls! Slower ball, full on off, Todd Astle judges this well and gets low to smoke this one well over deep mid-wicket.
A pacy length delivery outside off, Todd Astle reaches out and works this past point for a couple of runs.
Around off and middle, heaved to the long on region for a run.
FOUR! Over the fielder at mid off! A full toss, around off and middle, Ish Sodhi lofts this one over the leaping mid off fielder for a boundary. Sodhi moves into the 20s.
Outside off, bunted back to Chris by Ish.
Yorker, around off, Todd Astle digs this one past Jordan, to the left of long on for a single.
Full toss on middle, knocked to the leg side for one. 29 more needed from 12 balls!
The slower one again, around middle, Ish Sodhi is taken by surprise as he lets out a laugh after he awkwardly pulls this to square leg for one.
On middle, it is the slower one again, Mills blocks it to the right of Tymal.
Todd Astle guides this one to the short third man fielder for one.
Slower again on the pads, Sodhi tickles this through short fine leg for one.
Off-pace, back of a length, on middle, Sodhi is early into the pull shot and misses.
Tymal Mills (3-0-20-0) comes back into the attack.

Update - India have won their warm-up game against Australia by 9 wickets whereas Namibia have managed to outclass the Netherlands, all thanks to the knock from David Wiese. They have opened their account and made Group A very interesting.
Just 4 off this. Yorker, way outside off, Astle reaches out but fails to connect.
Around off, Ish hits this one through mid on for one.
Another fuller delivery, around off, Todd makes room and bunts this through covers for one.
Outside off on a length, slower ball, Astle flashes but misses this time.
Fuller, around off, hit to the mid off region for one.
Length delivery on the pads, nudged to the left of short fine leg for one.
Chris Jordan comes into the attack now.
Fuller, on off, Todd Astle hits it to the extra cover fielder in the ring. Takes a single. 37 needed off 24 balls, is there some life left in this chase?

FIVE WIDES! The ball has missed everything! Chris Woakes delivers this way too wide outside the off stump. Maybe Todd Astle going across his crease made him bowl that wide. But he gets it too wide for anyone to stop it as the ball goes away from Jos Buttler for a boundary at third man.
Length ball, outside off, Ish Sodhi drills it to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Second maximum of the over! Shortish delivery around off, Ish Sodhi backs away and hammers this over long on for another biggie.
WIDE! Chris Woakes delivers this down the leg side. Ish Sodhi tries to get his bat on that one but misses. Wide called.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Length ball, in the slot for Ish Sodhi. He clears his front leg and tonks it over long on for a biggie.
Fuller, on off, Todd Astle hits it to mid off and gets a single.
Length ball, on off, Ish Sodhi works it away towards mid on and gets another quick single.
Chris Woakes (2-0-8-0) comes back into the attack.
On a length, Ish Sodhi pushes it to covers and sets off for a quick single. Skipper Morgan collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Single taken
Back of a length, on off, Ish Sodhi blocks it off the back foot.
Length ball, on off, Todd Astle pushes it to covers for a single.
Todd Astle is the last man to come in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Length ball, Tim Southee backs away again and looks to heave away across the line. Gets an inside edge to the wicketkeeper, Jos Buttler. He takes a fine low catch. Hat-trick ball coming up.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: Ish Sodhi walks out now.

OUT! Mark Wood gets another one! Back of a length, on the stumps, Kyle Jamieson backs away and looks to go over covers but miscues. The ball goes high in the air and Jordan running from mid off takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, in the line of the stumps, Tim Southee backs away and slaps it to long on for a single.
A full toss, around middle, worked to deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length, on off, tapped to covers for one.
Off-pace again, around off, Tim bunts this past the bowler and crosses ends.
On the pads, on a length, Kyle clips this to deep square leg for a run.
Slower now, fuller outside off, KJ looks to hit it over mid on but fails to connect.
A short ball, angling away outside off, Kyle Jamieson makes room and looks to push this on the off side but misses.
A short ball, around middle and leg, Tim Southee makes room and looks to hit it across the line but misses.
Good-length ball on off, KJ lofts this one over the mid off region and picks up a run.
On a good length, around off, Kyle pushes this to covers.
Around off, defended out by Kyle.
Kyle Jamieson comes out now.

OUT! TAKEN! A great catch is taken and the 7th wicket falls. Wood strikes and the Kiwis slip further. Daryl Mitchell looked to go hard at this but he loses his wicket in the process. A shortish ball, around off, Daryl Mitchell lines up to play the pull shot but he hits it towards the man at mid-wicket. Chris Woakes gets low and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Woakes b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, on a length, DM defends it to covers and yells a loud 'NO!' to his partner.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Fuller, on off, Southee lifts this over covers for a boundary. Good end of the over for New Zealand.
On off again, fuller, Mitchell pushes it to covers for a single.
Flatter ball, on off, Mitchell blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller again, at the line of the stumps,  Southee pushes it to long off for a single.
Fuller, on off, Southee pushes it to covers.
A length ball, on off. Daryl Mitchell pushes it towards long on for a single.
NO BALL! Full toss, over the waist height. Southee works it to long off and takes a run. The umpire signals a no ball. Free Hit coming...
Adil Rashid delivers this short again, Tim Southee pushes it towards long off for a single. Just 5 balls were bowled and the umpire has called over.
Shorter length, on off, Tim Southee gets back and blocks it.

OUT! TIMBER! Adil Rashid gets his second wicket of the over. New Zealand are in trouble now. Floated, full and around off. Mitchell Santner hangs back and looks to push it away but misses. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps. Santner should have been forward but was beaten in the flight.
Full and on off. Santner pushes it to covers.
OUT! Gone! Rashid bowls the googly on the off stump line, Chapman looks to cut but gets an outside edge to first slip. Jordan there takes a good sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: DRINKS! New Zealand looked to be in a comfortable position but a flurry of wickets has put them in a spot of bother. They would hope the current pair takes the game deep. England have bounced back in this game and have made it difficult for the batters to score. Can they keep the similar pressure?

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A good end to the over by Liam Livingstone. He picks up his first wicket. Short and outside off. The ball is turning away. Glenn Phillips hangs back and looks to cut it but the ball takes the outside edge and Jos Buttler does well behind the stumps to catch it. New Zealand's innings going downstairs now.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Liam Livingstone

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, full and on off. Chapman defends it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle. Chapman clips it to short fine leg.
A single as this is worked to mid on.
FOUR! Nicely played. Full and outside off. Phillips leans in and slashes it through point for a boundary.
Full and on off. Chapman defends it out.
Mark Chapman walks out now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Excellent work by the fielder in the deep. Flatter and on off. Conway pushes it to deep backward point. The batters look to take two runs. Sam Billings collects the ball and throws it to the keeper at the striker’s end. Jos Buttler does well to collect the ball and clip the bails off. Conway is found short in the replays.
Tossed up, outside off. Conway looks to reverse sweep it but misses.
FOUR! And again! Conway sweeps again and gets a similar result. Full and on off. Conway prods and sweeps it through square leg for another boundary.

FOUR! Clears the man in the deep. Floated, full and on leg. Conway gets low and sweeps it towards deep square leg. The fielder in the deep covers a lot of ground to his right, he puts in a dive but in vain.
Loopy ball, full and on off. Conway comes forward and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller, on the pads, Devon Conway flicks it to backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off, Glenn Phillips punches it off the back foot towards backward point for a single.
Shorter length, on off, Devon Conway pulls it to long on for just a single.
Back of a length, on the pads, Devon Conway works it away towards the on side.
Fuller and on middle. Phillips tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on the pads, Devon Conway clips it to backward square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, on off, Devon Conway reverse-sweeps it to short third man for a single.
Fuller, this time on off, Devon Conway pushes it to mid off.
Googly, turning away from Conway. He pushes it to short third man.
Glenn Phillips walks out at number 4.

OUT! Adil Rashid strikes in the very next ball after being hit for a six! Tossed up, googly on middle and off. Martin Guptill stays in his crease and looks to go big down the ground. But fails to get enough distance on that as his one hand comes off the handle. The ball flies off the toe end of the bat and Jason Roy takes the simplest of catches at wide long on.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! Tossed up, in the line of the stumps, Martin Guptill slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller, on the stumps, Devon Conway drives it to long on for a single.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack now. He replaces Mark Wood.
A single now as Devon pushes this towards mid on. At the end of the Powerplay, New Zealand are at 59/1 and they need 105 more from 84 balls!

FOUR! It was the slower one but Conway gets a boundary. He anticipates this one well, it is bowled around off and middle, Devon Conway just works this one behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
On the pads, nudged to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Slightly shorter this time, a good amount of pace on this delivery, Martin Guptill rocks back and punches this one through covers for a boundary. Martin is looking in fine touch!
Fuller this time, wider outside off, MG reaches out but fails to connect.
Slower, around off, length, nudged to the leg side for a quick single.
Around off, shorter, Guptill mishits this one towards long on for a couple. 17 off this one.
Tymal Mills comes into the attack now.
WIDE. A bumper now, around leg, Guptill ducks away. Wided.
FOUR! And again! Martin Guptill has started off really well! Back of a length, around off and middle, angling in, Martin Guptill moves to the leg side slightly and bangs this one over mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! A touch shorter, around off, Martin Guptill stands tall and powers this one over the mid on region for a boundary.
Bowled slightly short, around the body, Conway looks to pull but misses and the ball takes the pad and goes to the leg side for a leg bye.
Back of a length, around middle and leg, Martin Guptill looks to flick but misses and the ball takes his pad and goes to the off side. The batters take a leg bye.
FOUR! This time Martin Guptill uses the pace of Wood and fetches a boundary! A half-volley, around off, Martin Guptill makes some room and gently lofts this one over mid off. One bounce and four!
Fuller, on middle and leg, Martin Guptill pushes it to mid on for just a single.
On a length, on the stumps, Devon Conway advances again and looks to work it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards short third man. The batters take a leg bye.
Length ball, Devon Conway skips down the track but gets no timing again as he only manages to hit it back to the bowler.
On a length again, outside off, Devon Conway pushes it to backward point. Another dot ball.
On a length, on off, Devon Conway looks to drive but gets no timing on that one. The ball rolls away from the strip.
Full ball, outside off, Devon Conway drives it to the cover-point fielder in the ring
Back of a length, on off, Devon Conway gets the inside half of his blade as he looks to push it towards covers. Gets a single towards backward square leg.
Devon Conway walks out at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! Mark Wood beats the batter with his sheer pace! He hurls across a delivery which is on the shorter side around off, Tim Seifert rocks back to punch it down the ground but his bat comes down late and the ball hurries through him to shatter the stumps. First wicket for England.
On a length, around off, Martin Guptill pushes it to backward point for a single.
WIDE! Short and pacy delivery but way down the leg side. Martin Guptill looks to pull but misses. Wided.
On a length and on the stumps, Martin Guptill pushes it off the back foot towards mid on.
FOUR LEG BYES! Fuller again, on the pads this time, Martin Guptill looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and races away towards the fine leg boundary.
Full, on off, Tim Seifert pushes it to mid on for a single.
Mark Wood comes into the attack now. He replaces Liam Livingstone.
This is pushed through covers for a single. A tidy start by Woakes, just 7 off this one.
Good-length ball, around off, angling in, the flick is what Guptill wanted to play, but he gets a leading edge through covers for a run.
Around off, Martin Guptill looks to defend but gets an inside edge back onto his pad.
On a fuller length, on middle, clipped to the right of mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! Tim Seifert gets his first boundary here. He steps out well to this shortish delivery around off and thwacks this one through backward point for a boundary.
Chris Woakes begins with a back-of-a-length delivery around off, Tim pushes this to the mid off region.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the other end.
SIX! A six to start and a six to end the over! Great shot. Fuller, around off, Martin Guptill swings this one hard and well over the bowler for a massive biggie. 14 of the opening one.
Tim Seifert opens his account by tucking this ball through wide mid on.
Some turn now! Floated, around off, the ball lands and spins away as Tim Seifert looks to block. He gets beaten though.
A full toss on the pads now, nudged through mid on for a single.
Flatter now, outside off, Guptill looks to slash it away but misses.

SIX! What a shot that is to start with! Guppy does not take long to get going! Fuller, tossed up, around off, Martin Guptill gets low and mows a slog-sweep well over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. The Kiwis are underway!
